func Breakdown(since time.Time) Spending
func Entries(since time.Time, filter map[string]string) []Entry
type Entry struct{Time time.Time; RequestID string; CorrelationID string; Operation string; Model string; Provider string; Usage schemaflux.Usage; Cost schemaflux.Cost; Tags map[string]string}
func Export(since time.Time, format string) (string, error)
func ForRequest(requestID string) (Entry, bool)
type Limits struct{Daily float64; Weekly float64; Monthly float64; Enforce bool; OnThreshold func(spent float64, limit float64, period string)}
type Model struct{Provider string; Name string; Input float64; Output float64; Cached float64; Reasoning float64}
func Models() []string
func Price(u schemaflux.Usage, model string, provider string) schemaflux.Cost
func Register(m Model) (restore func(), err error)
func Reset()
func SetHistoryLimit(n int) (restore func())
func SetLimits(b Limits) (restore func(), err error)
type Spending struct{ByModel map[string]float64; ByOperation map[string]float64; ByProvider map[string]float64; Total float64}
func Spent(since time.Time, filter map[string]string) (usd float64, complete bool)
func Summarize(since time.Time, filter map[string]string) Summary
type Summary struct{Requests int; Unpriced int; Usage schemaflux.Usage; Cost schemaflux.Cost}
